about: The questions behind My alignment and the Ideology tab. Each has two sides (sides[0] and sides[1]); liberal is the index of the liberal side, or null when the question splits both parties or has no left-right side (those count in My alignment but not in the lean or the compass); axis is the compass axis it counts on (econ: across, social: up and down), or null. groups names the interest groups whose scorecard is about the question, each with the side a high rating from it favors (public/question-scores.js ratingItems); groups that rate across many topics are on no question. "added" questions are ours, for votes the quiz has no question for. Ids never change once published: rewording keeps the evidence gathered for a question; a change of meaning gets a new id.
credit: Questions modeled on the topics of iSideWith.com's political quiz (https://www.isidewith.com/political-quiz), in our own wording, with questions added for votes the quiz doesn't cover.
